name: Knysna Central and the Waterfront
tagline: The town centre on the lagoon, with the quays and the oysters
description: The compact centre on the northern shore of the lagoon, with the Waterfront development, the quays where the oyster boats tie up, and Main Street holding the shops, restaurants and services. Everything practical in Knysna is within a few minutes of here.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the restaurants, the quays and the shops on foot
pros: All shops, restaurants and services close by
Lagoon frontage and the boat trips to the Heads
The only walkable part of the town
cons: The highest rents, and higher again over the December holidays
Busy through the South African summer
Traffic on the N2 running through

name: The Heads and Eastford
tagline: Out at the sandstone cliffs where the lagoon meets the sea
description: The eastern headland above the two sandstone cliffs that guard the lagoon mouth, with houses stepped up the slope and views straight out to the open ocean. It is the most dramatic address in Knysna, quiet, residential, and about ten minutes from the centre by car.
bestFor: Stays where the view of the Heads and the ocean is the reason to be here
pros: The best views in Knysna, over the Heads and the sea
Coastal walks and the Featherbed reserve opposite
cons: High rents for anything with the view
Ten to fifteen minutes to the shops

name: Leisure Isle
tagline: The island in the lagoon, calm water and no through traffic
description: A residential island in the lagoon connected by a causeway, with tidal swimming beaches, quiet streets and no through traffic at all. It is one of the most settled and expensive addresses on the Garden Route, popular with retirees and holiday-home owners.
bestFor: Quiet stays with calm swimming water and no traffic
pros: Tidal swimming beaches on the lagoon
No through traffic and very quiet
cons: Very high rents and limited supply
No shops or restaurants on the island

name: Knysna Heights and Paradise
tagline: The residential slopes behind the town, the everyday value
description: The suburban streets climbing the hill behind the centre, with ordinary houses, local schools and views over the lagoon from the upper roads. It is where most permanent residents live, rents are well below the waterfront, and the centre is a short drive downhill.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a normal house at a rent below the waterfront
pros: Rents well below the lagoon and the Heads
Lagoon views from the upper streets
cons: Steep, and a car is needed

name: Rheenendal and the Knysna Forest
tagline: Inland among the indigenous forest and the old gold road
description: The farming and forest area northwest of the town, where the largest remaining indigenous forest in South Africa runs up towards the Outeniqua mountains, past the ghost workings at Millwood. Houses are scattered smallholdings, quiet and green, with a twenty-minute drive into town.
bestFor: Stays that want the indigenous forest and space, with a car
pros: Indigenous forest and mountain trails at the door
cons: Twenty to twenty-five minutes into Knysna
A car is essential and roads are partly gravel
Wildfire risk in dry, windy conditions
